Actual traversable approach cartway, no forced march, coach and horses healthy. No additional daytime occurrence check because D333 ordinary travel check71 already resolved quiet; authored tower arrival is not random. Inside fixed Spy, second Guard and antiquarian remain their existing posts, not revealed. No automatic faction knowledge of V or report delivered, no attack, initiative, payment, quest acceptance, identity disclosed at tower or entry yet. V next response to gate guard. Time Day333~15:35. All prior resources and custody unchanged except full day's provisions; LR2/6 unchanged, no rest.
